honestBound: the browser/screenshot inspection portion of `critique` + the interactive `live` browser-iteration flow were NOT run — the autonomous harness has no browser automation; Assessment A used SOURCE-BASED visual reasoning (it read the rendered HTML/CSS + the render source, not a rasterized screenshot). assessmentB_detector.tool: impeccable detect (deterministic, no LLM, no key, no browser-for-files)
assessmentB_detector.prePassFindings: the only findings over the rendered surface + the built stylesheet were em-dash-overuse (the committed reasoned exception — ORGΛNON's house-style em-dash in S36-frozen content; the constitution outranks the detector, Attack-11). ZERO structural anti-patterns (no side-tab, no purple gradient, no bounce/elastic, no flat-type, no cards-in-cards, no gray-on-color).
assessmentB_detector.postPassFindings: unchanged — 0 non-exception findings; the pass introduced no anti-pattern (surface_detector S38 green).

assessmentA_designReview.isolatedFromB: Assessment A ran WITHOUT the detector output (the isolation the critique spec requires — the design-director read is not anchored by the deterministic findings); the synthesis combined them afterward.
assessmentA_designReview.aiSlopVerdict: NO — a designer would not immediately think 'AI made this'. Authored, opinionated work: the near-monochrome dark ground, meaning-only semantic color, the non-color cue system, and the FACT/REASONING/BOUNDARY trust-tiering are a real, consistently-held point of view. The AI-slop tells (hero gradient, glassmorphism, emoji feature cards, three-column marketing grid, neon crypto tropes) are conspicuously absent by design.
assessmentA_designReview.nielsenMean: ≈3.3/4 — strong across the board; the recurring deduction is data-hierarchy/scan-ability, not correctness.
assessmentA_designReview.strongestPart: the emotional design of DOUBT — UNVERIFIED as a peer verdict (not a degraded one), SAMPLE's dashed-vs-solid provenance border, the calm slate/amber palette for 'unknown' (red reserved for AVOID/NO-GO) — makes uncertainty feel like honesty, not failure. This is the product's core value and it lands.

priorityFindings.title: the FACTS are not the loudest thing — live figures render in .muted (the quietest type); --mono is defined 'for metrics' but used only in the Pro <pre>
priorityFindings.how: added a .num class (mono + --ink + body size, all EXISTING tokens) and wrapped the live figures (headline APY, durable base, durable/advertised band anchors, funding-carry band) in <span class="num"> in reality.ts — a markup-class wrap, the number's text bytes untouched (S36 held byte-identical). The facts now pop OUT of the muted context that frames them.

priorityFindings.title: the per-axis tier glyphs (✓ ! ✗ ?) are bare uncolored same-weight text — the scorecard must be read row-by-row, not scanned
priorityFindings.how: wrapped the glyph in <span class="axis-tier {tier}"> and added CSS giving it the existing verdict color tokens + weight — the SHAPE cue (the glyph) is preserved AND a color+weight scan-rail is added; every pairing computed WCAG-AA on the ground (surface_designpass axis-tier assertion: SOLID 7.45, CAUTION 7.50, AVOID 5.65, UNVERIFIED 7.56 — all ≥ 4.5).

priorityFindings.title: --sp6 (32px) and --sp7 (48px) and the h2 type tier are DEFINED but used ZERO times — the vertical rhythm caps at 24px and the document outline is flat (only h1 + h3)
priorityFindings.how: promoted the three true Reality-Check section headers (The honesty scorecard · Quantitative · The overfit Stamp) from h3 to the existing-but-unused h2 tier, and bumped h2's top margin to the unused --sp6 — major sections now announce themselves as chapters. Pure composition; no token value changed; the tag change is stripped by the S36 content signature (content byte-identical).

priorityFindings.title: the .band .rng range track is a decorative green→amber gradient that encodes no data — an ornamental use of semantic color in a 'meaning-only' system
priorityFindings.how: neutralized .band .rng to a --border-strong rail; the meaning-bearing color now stays with the figures (.num) beside it, honoring the 'only colors carry meaning' thesis.

outOfScopeFindings.title: the SAMPLE shelf renders 'Contract screen: 4 of 3 applicable pools' — an impossible ratio (realTier=4 is a GLOBAL registry count; applicable=3 is the sample shelf's shown yield pools)
outOfScopeFindings.handling: NOT touched by the design pass (D16 is aesthetics-only + the content is S36-frozen). Recorded as a red-team finding to fix on the go in PART E — an impossible ratio on a trust surface is a genuine honesty defect; the fix moves a rendered number, so it needs a conscious, documented S36-golden re-capture for the two affected shelf screens + a re-pin (never a silent content drift). Surfaced here, not deferred silently.

outOfScopeFindings.title: the 💬/↻ chrome emoji are the one casual note among otherwise geometric glyphs
outOfScopeFindings.handling: left untouched — the copy is S36-frozen; noted for a future copy-unfreeze, not changed.

synthesis: The pinned ORGΛNON design system is genuinely strong and NOT AI-slop; the honesty semantics are its best-designed part and the detector confirms zero structural anti-patterns. The design intelligence's highest-value finding is that the product's own central claim — 'the FACTS are the loudest thing on screen' — was not yet TRUE in execution (the figures rendered in the quietest type). The pass applied four real, in-constraint craft improvements (P1 facts-loudest via mono/ink figures — the flagship; P2 a scannable colored tier rail; P3 real section rhythm from the previously-unused h2/--sp6; P4 retiring the one decorative gradient) — all as CSS-composition + markup-CLASS changes above the byte-frozen semantic tokens, with the content byte-identical (S36) and zero new dependency. One genuine correctness defect (W-SO01, '4 of 3') was surfaced and routed to the red-team, not silently patched into the aesthetics-only pass.
